trainer_v2.reward_alignment: cap 1.0 carried unchanged from run 3 (lowered 10.0 -> 1.0 there; still the ONLY reward delta from the predecessor). SPEEDRUN objective: score shaping is a discovery aid only and must never rival the +10 win bonus. Under the predecessor's cap of 10.0, a shaped truncation return could approach a win's return, and the predecessor duly farmed score without finishing (training wins frozen at 16 over 1,700+ episodes at 36-40 shots/episode). Under 1.0, the max shaped truncation return is ~= 1.0 minus the time penalty, far below the worst-case win return of ~= 8.6 (win +10, plus at most +1.0 shaping, minus 24000 ticks x 0.0001 time penalty = 2.4), so finishing strictly dominates farming everywhere in return space. Run 3b tests this cap on a WIN-ERA init instead of the farm-converged final.
trainer_v2.discounting_note: gamma applies PER MACRO STEP; the macro reward is the undiscounted per-tick sum over the ticks the macro consumed (~20-70), so 0.999 per macro is roughly 0.999^(1/40) per native tick; truncation is reward-neutral (v2 wrapper), so 24000-tick late-level truncations bootstrap instead of paying -10
